package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type discardLogger struct{}

func (discardLogger) Error(string, error, string) {}

type eventSinkStub struct{ items []domain.Event }

func (stub *eventSinkStub) Publish(_ context.Context, event domain.Event) error {
	stub.items = append(stub.items, event)
	return nil
}

type activityPublisherStub struct{ items []domain.InterestingActivity }

func (stub *activityPublisherStub) PublishInterestingActivity(_ context.Context, activity domain.InterestingActivity) error {
	stub.items = append(stub.items, activity)
	return nil
}

func TestPublishBatchEmitsBoundedRepeatedFailureSignal(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &eventSinkStub{}
	publisher := &activityPublisherStub{}
	service := NewEventService(sink, discardLogger{}, publisher)
	userID, sessionID, courseID, lessonID, taskID, eventID := uuid.New(), uuid.New(), uuid.New(), uuid.New(), uuid.New(), uuid.New()
	accepted, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), RequestMeta{UserID: userID, Role: "STUDENT"}, EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID: courseID, LessonID: lessonID, TaskID: taskID, Platform: "web", EditorMode: "go",
		Events: []IncomingEvent{{
			EventID: eventID, SessionID: sessionID, EventType: domain.EventTypeTestFailed,
			Payload: map[string]any{"consecutive_failures": 3, "same_error_count": 3, "active_seconds": 480, "error_fingerprint": "assertion-x"},
		}},
	})
	if err != nil || accepted != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("publish batch: accepted=%d err=%v", accepted, err)
	}
	if len(publisher.items) != 1 || publisher.items[0].SignalType != "repeated_failure" || publisher.items[0].EventID != eventID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected interesting activity: %+v", publisher.items)
	}
	if publisher.items[0].StudentID != userID || publisher.items[0].AnalyticsSessionID != sessionID {
		t.Fatalf("activity identity drift: %+v", publisher.items[0])
	}
}

func TestPublishBatchKeepsImprovingFailuresSilent(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &eventSinkStub{}
	publisher := &activityPublisherStub{}
	service := NewEventService(sink, discardLogger{}, publisher)
	_, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "STUDENT"}, EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID: uuid.New(), LessonID: uuid.New(), TaskID: uuid.New(), Platform: "web", EditorMode: "go",
		Events: []IncomingEvent{{
			EventID: uuid.New(), SessionID: uuid.New(), EventType: domain.EventTypeTestFailed,
			Payload: map[string]any{"same_error_count": 2, "active_seconds": 600, "progressing": true},
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish batch: %v", err)
	}
	if len(publisher.items) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("improving activity should remain silent: %+v", publisher.items)
	}
}

func TestPublishBatchRequiresStableEventIDForInterestingActivity(t *testing.T) {
	service := NewEventService(&eventSinkStub{}, discardLogger{}, &activityPublisherStub{})
	_, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "STUDENT"}, EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID: uuid.New(), LessonID: uuid.New(), TaskID: uuid.New(), Platform: "web", EditorMode: "go",
		Events: []IncomingEvent{{SessionID: uuid.New(), EventType: domain.EventTypeStudentStuck, Payload: map[string]any{}}},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidInput) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid input, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPublishBatchRejectsInvalidActivityBeforeAcceptance(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &eventSinkStub{}
	service := NewEventService(sink, discardLogger{}, &activityPublisherStub{})
	accepted, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "STUDENT"}, EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID: uuid.New(), LessonID: uuid.New(), TaskID: uuid.New(), Platform: "web", EditorMode: "go",
		Events: []IncomingEvent{{
			EventID: uuid.New(), SessionID: uuid.New(), EventType: domain.EventTypeStudentIdle,
			Payload: map[string]any{"idle_seconds": 86401},
		}},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidInput) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid input, got %v", err)
	}
	if accepted != 0 || len(sink.items) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid activity was accepted: accepted=%d events=%d", accepted, len(sink.items))
	}
}
